text: At 34 minutes, Harbour City's Marek Barros had a big chance to score from just 4.3 meters, thanks to a clever through ball from Joon Whitfield. The chance was a close one—Barros’s shot had an xG of 0.668, meaning he would usually score about 7 times in 10 from this spot, but it was blocked. This chance came after Harbour City patiently built play with two quick short passes over 7 seconds, showing their careful and precise style against Seabrook Town’s wide, crossing approach. The match stayed 0-0 after this moment[#672] [#670] [#669] [#667].
